summary: Synchronously list fs.Dirent values for readdirSync({withFileTypes:true}) without eagerly following every entry.

semantics.dirent_methods: isFile/isDirectory/isSymbolicLink and other type tests reflect directory-entry metadata

caveats: Mapping to FileSystemInfo alone can accidentally follow links or lose unknown entry types.
Some filesystems do not provide reliable d_type information; helper may need lstat-compatible fallback while preserving errors.

tests.name: directory entry type
tests.expected_behavior: the Dirent for a real subdirectory reports isDirectory() true

tests.name: symlink is not followed for Dirent kind
tests.expected_behavior: a symbolic-link directory entry can report isSymbolicLink() true rather than being converted to its target type
